name: frenzy
text: frenzy is a MacKillop cross-reference headword that points the reader to the entry for battle fury. Related terms MacKillop gathers beside it include warp spasm, the heroic battle fit of Cúchulainn. No independent entry sits under frenzy in the 2008 dictionary.
